Explanations

  • D2PT Rating

    D2PT Rating is a performance metric for heroes that is based on performance with and against other heroes, win rate and pick phase.

  • Most Played Build WR

    Shows the winrate of the most played build for the hero (this implies position choice).

  • Lane

    The three values represent percentages of Won/Draw/Lost lane. A lane is won if the team's lane advantage on that lane is 8% or higher. Between -8% and 8% it is a draw.

  • Lane Advantage

    Lane advantage is the relative amount of networth one team is ahead of the other team on a lane.

  • Stage Trend

    Shows Winrate and number of matches for different stages of a match. Mid = Minute 12 to 35, Late = Minute 35 to 50, Late+ = Minute 50+

  • Contest Rate

    Percentage of matches where the hero was banned or picked.

  • Expert

    This column shows the number of matches and winrates of players who recently played the hero more than 10 times.

  • 1st Phase / 2nd Phase / Lastpick

    Refers to the phase of the match when the hero was picked in a ranked match.

  • Networth@10

    Average Hero Networth at 10 minutes into the match. The number in brackets use the standard deviation of the hero's networth to show the range of the hero's networth.

  • Filters

    The filter can be used to filter by hero name or to threshold values of different columns. For example: expert>60 will filter for heroes that have an expert winrate above 60%. You can use multiple filters together, for example matches<1000, phase1>50, and combine them with sorting by columns.

    Hero Filtering: You can filter for specific heroes by typing their names separated by commas. For example: Anti-Mage, Pudge, Invoker will show only those three heroes. The bookmark icon next to the filter allows you to quickly filter by your bookmarked heroes from the /heroes page.

    URL Bookmarking: All filter settings (hero filters, statistical filters, and match range) are automatically saved in the URL. You can bookmark any filtered view or share the URL with others to show the exact same results.
